s: Dine sika beshabbat ubo h' seipim: hachoshesh bemotnayv — lo yasuk shemen vechometz (meorabim), mippene sheen derek lasuk bahem ella lirpua, vekol shehaddabar nikkar shemmitkavven lirpua — asur, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman shk"ch. Abal sak hu bashshemen (lebaddo), abal lo beshemen vered, lepi sheddamayv yeqarim veeno matzuy, veen regilim lasuk bo ella lirpua. Veim hu maqom shemmatzuy bo shemen vered vederek bene adam lesuko shello lirpua — muttar lasuk bo apillu lirpua. Ubimqomot ellu sheen nohagin lasuk bashshemen ki im lirpua — asur lasuk beshum shemen lirpua, mippene shehaddabar nikkar shemmitkavven lirpua. Velaken asur lasuk harosh sheyyesh bo chatatin:
Muttar lasuk ulemashmesh beyad al kol haggup lahanaa. Ubilbad sheyyeshanneh midderek chol, dehaynu sheyyasuk vimashmesh beyachad, velo yemashmesh bekoach ella beripyon yadayim:

En megordin bikli hamyuchad lekak kederek chol, ella im ken hayu yadayv o raglayv metunnapot betit o tzoa. Veim haya lo megaredet hamyuchedet leshabbat — muttar. Umizzeh nahagu habbetulot lihyot lahen keli missear chazir hamyuchad leshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"g:

Lo yasuk raglo bashshemen keshehi betok hamminal o hassandal hachadashim, mippene sheoran mitrakkek al yede likluk hashshemen, vedomeh leibbud. Abal sak hu et raglo veachar kak mannichah bamminal, vesak hu et kol gupo umitaggel al gabbe haor, veeno choshesh. Vehu shello yehe bashshemen hannishshop miggupo shiur kede leabbedo, apillu yesh bo kede letzachtzecho — muttar. Vehu shello yitkavven hu apillu letzachtzecho, gezera mishshum leabbedo:
Haddores al haor ad sheyyitqashsheh, o hamrakkeko beyadayv umosheko umashveh oto kederek shehaummanim osim —chayyab mishshum meabbed:
